task.description: Review ISS-0047's fix (commit 548c338, plus an unrelated one-file/no-behavior-change unblock commit 3b4a562 shortening an over-255-char ExUnit test name in test/letflow/identity_test.exs, applied directly by ORCH under ORCHESTRATOR.md sec10's sizing exception since it blocked verifying this fix) on branch feature/WF03-ISS0047-20260818. Security review already PASSed (step-03b). Check idiomatic OTP/Elixir usage, module boundary/scope creep, and consistency with existing decision records -- specifically that the fix does not silently re-decide anything docs/migration/decisions/ already settled (e.g. Decision 0006's per-tenant schema approach, or the module's own documented 'not Ecto.Multi, not naive insert-then-rescue' constraint above upsert_by_external_identity/4).
acceptance_criteria: New helpers (username_unique_conflict?/1, get_by_username/2, identity_matches?/2) follow the module's existing style/idiom conventions.
No scope creep beyond the validated design.
Confirms the fix doesn't contradict any docs/migration/decisions/ record.
mix compile --warnings-as-errors and MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test test/letflow/identity_test.exs both verified directly (re-run, don't trust ELIXIR-DEV's report alone).

CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's one MINOR non-blocking note (design's rescue-based framing understates Ecto's own unique_constraint/3 mechanism) -- confirm it's still non-blocking post-implementation, or address if it now matters.

result.summary: Implementation (identity.ex diff vs origin/main) matches the approved design's §2.2-§2.5 shape verbatim: the three-way branch replacing the old `{:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}} = error -> error` clause, and the three new private helpers (username_unique_conflict?/1, get_by_username/2, identity_matches?/2), are all present with the exact @specs, logic shape, and comments the design specified -- no deviation, no scope creep. Idiom check: pattern-matches on an already-returned, already-typed Ecto.Changeset.t() (same idiom as the pre-existing line 216 clause) -- not a try/rescue, so it does not violate the module's own documented 'not a naive insert-then-rescue' constraint above upsert_by_external_identity/4 (design §2.1's argument holds up against the actual diff). No Ecto.Multi introduced. New helpers are plain Repo.get_by/3 reads matching get_by_external_identity/3's existing idiom/visibility/placement. Supervision N/A (this module has no process/supervision tree -- pure Ecto context functions). Decision 0006 consistency: get_by_username/2's comment correctly attributes username's now-per-schema uniqueness to Decision 0006/REQ-063 and adds no tenant_id filter, consistent with D2's column drop and get_by_external_identity/3's existing precedent of not filtering on tenant_id either. No re-decision of anything in 0006 found. CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's MINOR note (rescue-framing vs unique_constraint/3) remains non-blocking post-implementation -- the shipped code doesn't use rescue anywhere, so the note was about the design doc's prose, not a code risk, and nothing here made it matter more. Type-safety: no new class of invalid state introduced (booleans/nil-or-struct returns, no new invalid representable state) -- not filing a type-safety issue. Minor non-blocking observation: design's OQ-2 (anti-patterns.md entry for on_conflict's single-arbiter limitation) has not yet been added to docs/anti-patterns.md -- worth DOC-UPDATER or a follow-up picking this up, but not a gate condition for this review. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean, no output/warnings. MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test test/letflow/identity_test.exs: '30 tests, 0 failures'. The 3b4a562 test-name-shortening commit is confirmed cosmetic (describe/test string text only, no assertion/setup changes) via diff inspection.
